title: Closing Off a Hotel Rate Plans Stay and Taking What Is Owed at Departure
content:
When a guest leaves, a Hotel Rate Plans stay is closed off and the folio total settled at departure is taken from the card on file. This note states what that closing is and how it is recorded.

## What governs the balance

**The balance settled at departure is struck only once the folio carries the statutory tax due on the room money for the stay.**

**The balance settled at departure is struck only once the folio carries the property credit drawn down against the charges it may be spent against.**

While either of those lines is absent from the reservation's folio, the balance settled at departure is not struck.

## The capability that records it

`settle_departure_balance_f8243430` closes off a hotel stay when the guest leaves and records what is taken from the card on file. One call marks the named reservation as departed, stamps it with the date the guest left and writes the folio total settled at departure as the amount stated, so the guest sees the stay shown as departed and that figure as what was taken. No folio line is added or removed.

## How it is invoked

The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk. It is not a tool the guest runs.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stay_reservation_id` | the internal reference number of the hotel reservation being closed off | an identifier, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call |
| `closing_balance_usd` | the folio total settled at departure | a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the second decimal and at no earlier point, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol; zero is written 0.0 and means nothing is taken from the card |

Neither parameter carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A single line of confirmation text. It names the reference of the reservation now shown as departed, the date of departure recorded on it as a calendar date in the year, month and day order, and the folio total settled at departure as a USD figure with two decimal places. The text coming back at all is what indicates the stay was closed off; an absent line or an error text means the reservation is untouched.
